title: Numeric and list arguments could not take a reference to an input or step
problem: Number fields in a pipeline step were plain number inputs, so a value like {{input.gas_price}} could not be typed. List fields always split on commas into strings, so a whole list such as {{curve.points}} could not be passed and numeric lists arrived as text.
fix: Number fields take a number or a {{...}} reference and say which when the text is neither. List fields keep a single reference whole and turn numeric items into numbers. Covered by e2e/uat_energy_trading_ui.spec.ts.

title: Pipeline step output was cut at 500 characters
problem: The step replay showed the 500 character preview kept on each step, so a long result such as a 6 month forward curve ended mid-list with no way to see the rest.
fix: The Output panel shows the node's full result, which the run already keeps, and falls back to the preview for older runs.

title: A code_asset step had no asset picker
problem: In a pipeline the code_asset step asked for a raw asset UUID in a text box, while the agent builder offered a list. A user had to dig the id out of the API.
fix: The step picks from the ready assets, shows a building or failed asset's status, and lists the fields the code reads with required ones marked. The id is saved. Covered by e2e/uat_energy_trading_ui.spec.ts.

title: Text from templates reached typed tool arguments as text
problem: Pipeline inputs and many step outputs are text, so a string input like 33.8, 34.6 reached realized_vol_calc.prices as one string and the tool refused it.
fix: Before a tool runs the engine turns text into the declared type one level deep: numbers, integers, booleans, objects and lists of numbers. Text that does not convert is passed through for the tool to report. Unit tests in tests/test_pipeline_coerce.py.

title: Step labels were unknown to the live check and Run pipeline until the first save
problem: The builder sent steps without their labels to /api/pipelines/validate and to Run pipeline, so {{desk.result}} was flagged as an unknown node while building, and the upstream hint offered generated ids.
fix: Labels are sent with every step, and the Available from upstream hint inserts the label when it is unique. Unit tests in pipelineAgentNodes.test.ts.

title: Pipelines had no description field
problem: Pipeline Settings had nowhere to describe a pipeline, so every pipeline built in the UI showed No description provided on its chat page.
fix: Pipeline Settings has a Description field, saved with the pipeline.

title: The agent card kept the tool count from load time
problem: Adding tools on the canvas left the agent card at 1 tools when six were attached.
fix: The card counts the selected tools on every add and remove.

title: The model chip in the builder looked like the agent's model
problem: The top bar showed claude-haiku-4-5 next to an agent running Sonnet, with nothing saying it was the AI Validate model.
fix: The chip reads AI checks followed by the model.

title: Code generation showed raw provider errors and a made-up cost
problem: When generation fell back to the template the page printed the provider's 429 error dict, and a successful generation always reported a cost of 0.02.
fix: The fallback says the AI service is busy or unavailable and that the template runs as is. Real token counts are returned and the invented cost is gone.
